title: Improved junta approximation for threshold functions
statement:
Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube that is a linear threshold function, and let $0<\varepsilon<1/2$ and $0<\eta<1/2$. There exist a coordinate set $J\subseteq[n]$ and a Boolean function $g$ depending on at most $|J|$ coordinates such that
\[|J|\le 1+\frac{I(f)^{2+\eta}}{\varepsilon^{1+\eta}}\left(\left(\frac{2}{\eta}+1\right)^2\right)^{\lceil16/\varepsilon^2\rceil},\]
the Fourier weight of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ on sets $S\subseteq J$ with $|S|\le\lceil16/\varepsilon^2\rceil$ is at least all but $2\varepsilon$ of its total weight, and the relative Hamming distance between $f$ and $g$ is at most $\varepsilon$. Here $I(f)$ is the total influence of the real-valued sign representation of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
